rows.text: Standing rule from the user: never merge pull requests yourself. Push to the PR branch and let the user do the merge.

Reviewer gotcha: when comparing a timestamptz column in SQL cursors, decode the cursor's createdAt to a Date (decodeCursor in apps/api/src/lib/cursor.ts does; malformed cursors raise InvalidCursorError, a 400); passing an ISO string forces an implicit cast and the index is not used.
The dashboard date range picker keeps its selection in the URL as ?range=<preset>, defaulting to 30d; it uses router.replace so the back button is not flooded.

apps/web stack and decisions: auth is Clerk (moved off Auth0 in August, ACME-171; middleware.ts); web deploys on Vercel with a preview deployment per PR; UI is shadcn/ui plus Tailwind; TanStack Query for server state, zustand for client state; no Redux.
Decision (July): form posts in apps/web use server actions instead of API routes; do not add new files under app/api/ for form submissions. app/api only holds webhooks.

The repo uses pnpm (not yarn) and lint is Biome run as `pnpm lint` at the root, not ESLint; web commands are `pnpm --filter web dev|test|build`. The apps/web README still says yarn/ESLint and the user will update it later.
Team: Lena is the frontend owner, Marco is backend, Priya is infra. Marco wrote docs/architecture/payments.md; Lena flagged the web onboarding doc as stale.

Invoice numbers display as INV-000123: prefix INV, zero-padded to 6 digits, numbers over 999999 print as-is; helper is formatInvoiceNumber in apps/web/lib/format-invoice-number.ts (throws RangeError for negative or non-integer).

The customers table defaults to sort by last activity, newest first (nuqs defaults sort=lastActivity, dir=desc in useCustomerQueryState). The invoices filter hook was renamed useInvoiceFilters -> useInvoiceQueryState.

apps/web cleanup candidates: lib/legacy-session.ts is dead code (only a type named Auth0Profile); apps/web/.env.example has unused AUTH0_DOMAIN/AUTH0_CLIENT_ID and lacks NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST and SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN; the README link to docs/frontend/testing.md moved to docs/web/testing.md.

Pending (parked by the user): add API request timing, logging method, matched route pattern (e.g. /v1/invoices/:id, not raw URL), status code and duration in ms for every request, as a plugin next to apps/api/src/plugins/request-id.ts using the existing logger so lines carry the request id.

apps/api/scripts/seed.ts is seeded with faker.seed(20260921) and builds unique emails like first.last.<org>-<index>@example.com (random faker emails collided on the unique index); run as `pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/seed.ts --reset`.
apps/web is Next.js 15 (15.0.3) with the App Router; there is no pages/ directory. Route groups under app/: (marketing), (auth), (dashboard), api (webhooks only).
global-error.tsx in apps/web reports to Sentry with the Next error digest as tag `digest` and extra data, and shows it on the error page as "Error id", so Sentry events can be matched to server logs.

Gotcha: do not format dates with toLocaleDateString(undefined, ...) in SSR components; it causes hydration mismatches (server en-US vs browser locale). Use next-intl useFormatter().dateTime(...) as customer-row.tsx does.
The api is Fastify (plugins in apps/api/src/plugins, FastifyReply helpers) with drizzle and zod.

Staging worker issue: image-resize jobs take 7.5-9s but services/worker/src/queues/image-resize.ts sets lockDuration: 5000, so jobs stall and run twice (144 double-processed on 2026-09-21, none dead-lettered). The user said to change the lock later; fix is lockDuration ~60000 or remove the override (default 30s).

API convention: errors are returned as RFC 7807 problem+json via the problem() helper in apps/api/src/lib/problem.ts, including 400/404/409; rows are soft-deleted with a deleted_at column, never hard deleted (list and get filter deleted_at IS NULL).

Ticket acme-247: DELETE /v1/customers/:id soft-deletes (deleted_at), returns 204; 400 invalid id, 404 missing, 409 if the customer has open invoices (draft, sent, overdue) with type URI https://docs.acme.dev/errors/customer-has-open-invoices (page does not exist yet). The UI says "Archive customer" instead of delete (DeleteCustomerButton, server action deleteCustomer). Merged to main as PR #427.
Preference: the user wants concise answers, code plus 1-2 lines of explanation, not long write-ups.

Unresolved: after every prod deploy there is a burst of odd postgres errors through the connection pooler (pooler service on port 6432 per infra/helm/api/values.yaml), then it settles. The user remembers a known gotcha about the pooler setup and what the db driver (postgres-js in apps/api/src/db/client.ts) needs, but it is not documented; commit c81e02a rewrote the client options and may have dropped an option. Ask the user to confirm the pooler mode.

Testing and dependency conventions (docs/onboarding.md): unit tests use Vitest, end-to-end tests use Playwright; Renovate opens dependency update PRs every Monday, patch updates are automerged once CI is green, minor and major updates need human review.

CSV exports in apps/api use csvRow/csvCell from apps/api/src/lib/csv.ts: RFC 4180 quoting for commas, quotes and newlines, and a leading ' on cells starting with = + - @ to block spreadsheet formula injection.
Customers search box debounces input by 300ms before updating the q URL param. Convention for text-input filters: keep local state, update URL query state after debounce.

Worker queue invoice-reminders (services/worker/src/queues/invoice-reminders.ts): BullMQ job scheduler runs daily at 13:00 UTC (9:00 Toronto), fans out one job per active org, which enqueues an email job per invoice due in 3 days with jobId invoice-reminder:<invoiceId>:<date> to avoid duplicates. The reminder email needs a pay link from the api's internal endpoint, wired via worker env API_URL.
Locally the api listens on port 4000 (PORT default in apps/api/src/env.ts and .env.example); the worker has API_URL defaulting to http://localhost:4000.

Invoice totals (apps/api/src/invoices/totals.ts) round each line's net and tax to whole cents first, then sum integers, so totals match the displayed line amounts; this fixed a one-cent mismatch flagged by customer Northwind. Already-issued invoices keep their stored totals; only new and edited invoices use the new math.

When adding fields to the public API (e.g. POST /v1/invoices), also update docs/api/invoices.md by hand so the integrations folks see them. POST /v1/invoices now has an optional memo (max 500 chars, internal only, not shown to the customer; column from migration 0042) besides notes (max 2000, shown on PDF).

Company profile settings form (apps/web settings/company): fields company name (required), tax id (optional), sender email for invoices (required); server action saveCompany PATCHes /v1/org/profile. A settings/company/page.tsx that loads and renders the profile was still to be written.
Staging is at staging.acme.dev and deploys automatically from main; https://staging.acme.dev/version returns the deployed sha and /healthz reports postgres and redis status.

Plan acme-252: add a private S3 bucket for invoice PDF exports on branch acme-252-invoice-export-bucket, with the team and env tags, public access blocked, encryption on. Where the uploads bucket is defined in infra/ (tool and folder) was unknown; the user will point to it. Infra changes go through normal CI plan/apply, never from the agent's machine.

The api enqueues background jobs to the worker with BullMQ (queues in apps/api/src/jobs/queue.ts: emails, pdf-render, invoice-pdf-export). The invoice-pdf-export job is enqueued with exportId and orgId and jobId invoice-pdf-export:<exportId>; the worker does not consume this queue yet (next piece of acme-252 work).

Standing fix for ERR_REQUIRE_ESM in acme-platform packages: set "type": "module" in the package's package.json, import local files with the .js extension, and use import/export instead of require()/module.exports. Applied to scripts/seed-demo (@acme/seed-demo).
Jordan is setting up a new work laptop (Sept 2026); the fresh clone of acme-platform is at ~/code/acme-platform. scripts/seed-demo needs Postgres running and DATABASE_URL set before `pnpm start`.
Standing rule from Jordan: for any large refactor, show a plan first and wait for explicit approval before touching any code.

Planned refactor of apps/api/src/routes/invoices.ts (917 lines): split into routes/invoices/ with index.ts, crud.ts, lifecycle.ts, pdf.ts, export.ts, schemas.ts, service.ts; OpenAPI output must stay byte-identical. Jordan said the plan looks fine but told Claude to hold off (as of 2026-09-24); not started. Coverage is weak for the PDF and export.csv routes (78.4% lines); computeTotals and loadInvoiceWithLines are imported by routes/payments.ts and emails/invoice-sent.tsx.

Gotcha: CI in acme-platform runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, so after adding or changing a dependency you must commit pnpm-lock.yaml too, otherwise the install job fails with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE.

Priya Shah's branch priya/acme-212-redis-sg adds an ingress rule (aws_security_group_rule.redis_from_worker, tcp/6379) letting the worker node security group reach Redis/ElastiCache, plus a variable worker_node_sg_id with no default that every environment must set. Marco needs it for the worker rollout (BullMQ consumers move to a new node group). Claude asked whether to push it to prod; Jordan has not authorized that.
Rule: any change under infra/ needs a review from the platform team and the terraform/plan output pasted into the PR description.
Rule of thumb from Jordan: never deploy to production on Fridays (also no prod release tags on Fridays).

Release tags in acme-platform are calendar-versioned like v2026.09.17 (latest at 2026-09-24); the changelog for the next tag is built from `git log <last tag>..origin/main`. Claude must not create or push a tag until Jordan says go.

To inspect web bundle size, run `ANALYZE=true pnpm --filter web build` (reports in apps/web/.next/analyze/). On 2026-09-24, /dashboard First Load JS was 461 kB (298 kB at last tag); biggest: recharts+d3 312 kB (revenue-chart.tsx), @clerk/nextjs 88 kB, full date-fns locale 71 kB.

The Drizzle ORM schema in apps/api/src/db/schema.ts is the single source of truth for tables; migrations in apps/api/drizzle/ are generated with `pnpm --filter api db:generate`. A nullable invoices.po_number column was added (migration 0042) but is not yet in the zod schemas or invoice DTO.

Gotcha: AWS Load Balancer Controller must be upgraded before the EKS cluster goes to 1.29. On 2026-09-16 staging had ~1h45m of ingress 404s because controller v2.6.2 could not reconcile after the 1.28 to 1.29 upgrade (fixed with v2.8.1). acme-prod still runs controller v2.6.2 (chart 1.6.2) on cluster 1.28; the controller step is still missing from infra/docs/runbooks/eks-upgrade.md.
Plan: acme-prod EKS 1.29 upgrade is pencilled in for 2026-10-06, owner Priya Shah. The AWS Load Balancer Controller upgrade from v2.6.2 must happen first.

Open issue as of 2026-09-24: a customer reported the acme CLI crashes on launch after updating; Claude could not reproduce with a fresh 2.4.1 build from main (--version, whoami, invoices list work). Waiting on support for the full error text, OS and runtime details. Jordan wants a patch release (2.4.2 via packages/cli/package.json) once understood.
The login page is apps/web/app/login/page.tsx and renders Clerk's SignIn component (path routing on /login, redirects to /dashboard).

The acme CLI (packages/cli) must support Node 18 and later: no newer APIs without a fallback (tsup target is node18). Known violation found 2026-09-24: Array.prototype.toSorted (Node 20+) in src/commands/invoices-export.ts:27 needs a fallback; also avoid import.meta.dirname/filename.
To switch kubectl context to prod: `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name acme-prod --region us-east-1`.
Rule: ask Jordan before adding a new dependency (npm/pnpm package).
Commit message convention: imperative mood subject (e.g. "Add po_number column to invoices") with a short body explaining why.

Postgres pool max is 10 connections per pod for the API (apps/api/src/db/client.ts), agreed by Jordan and Priya after staging 'too many connections'. Scale pods, not the pool. Reviewer note: pool size times max pods must stay under the PgBouncer limit.

The worker exposes Prometheus metrics on port 9464 at /metrics. The helm chart infra/helm/worker has a metrics values block, a named metrics Service port and a ServiceMonitor (30s) so Grafana scrapes it (branch acme-214-worker-servicemonitor).

API CSV export (apps/api/src/lib/csv.ts) quotes fields containing commas, quotes or newlines per RFC 4180 and uses CRLF line endings (Jordan chose to keep CRLF); download filename is invoices-<org slug>.csv. This changes the customer-facing file, so mention it in PR descriptions (branch acme-211-csv-export).

Local setup for acme-platform: clone acme/acme-platform, `nvm use`, `pnpm install`, `docker compose up -d db redis` (compose also defines mailpit), `pnpm --filter api db:migrate` once, then `pnpm dev` at the root (turbo run dev) starts web, api (port 4000) and worker. Local env variables come from Lena. Used for onboarding a contractor starting 2026-09-25.

Preference: keep diffs small, one concern per pull request; unrelated commits get split into their own branches cut from origin/main (e.g. acme-211-csv-export, acme-213-api-pool-max, acme-214-worker-servicemonitor).

New authenticated pages in apps/web go under apps/web/app/(dashboard)/ (gets sidebar/header layout, assumes signed-in user); public pages go in app/(marketing). Route group names are not in the URL. Lena wants a /reports page at app/(dashboard)/reports/page.tsx; Jordan has half-finished edits there in the working tree.

Gotcha: updating all apps/web deps to latest (acme-216-web-deps-latest) broke things: next-intl 4.1.0, recharts 3.0.0, tailwind-merge 3.0.1 and lucide-react 1.0.2 are major bumps causing 3 type errors and 13 test failures (Trash2 renamed TrashIcon, tooltip API, provider setup). Minor/patch bumps (@clerk/nextjs 6.9.6, zod 3.23.9, react-query 5.62.2) are fine; deps-bot PRs #1426/#1427 overlap.

billing-sync (services/worker/src/jobs/billing-sync.ts, every 15 min) can delay Stripe invoices 30+ minutes: it filters created >= lastRunAt, so drafts finalized later are skipped, and lastRunAt is set at run end rather than start. Suggested fix is event-based sync (invoice.finalized/paid) or recording start time plus overlap. It is billing code, so wait for Jordan's review before changing it. Not confirmed as the cause for finance's flagged invoices.

Web reads the API base URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL (apps/web/lib/api-client.ts), falling back to http://localhost:4000. On Vercel the variable exists only for Production, not Preview, so staging (a preview environment) calls localhost:4000; fix is to add it for Preview and redeploy (Jordan is sorting with Priya). reports/actions.ts uses server-side API_URL, a different variable.

acme-platform uses pnpm 9 (pinned pnpm@9.12.0) since the September 2026 migration off yarn 1; npm and yarn must not be used. They write their own lockfiles (package-lock.json / yarn.lock) and CI rejects the PR. The only-allow pnpm preinstall guard does not catch `yarn add`.

An untracked yarn.lock keeps reappearing in acme-platform (written locally 2026-09-29); something runs `yarn` in the repo, probably a VS Code extension or shell alias. Jordan said he would check his VS Code extensions; do not commit it. yarn.lock was deleted in 3c81d0e.

acme-platform contributing conventions: run `nvm use` (reads .nvmrc); copy .env.example to .env.local and fill secrets from 1Password; branch names start with the Linear id, e.g. acme-412-retry-webhooks.
Git hooks in acme-platform run through lefthook (lefthook.yml at repo root); husky was removed on 2026-09-29. Jordan wants any leftover .husky references removed.

The acme-platform API reads its database connection only from DATABASE_URL (commit 9e04b7a dropped the PG* fallbacks) and fails fast at boot if it is missing. apps/api/.env.local needs a DATABASE_URL line copied from .env.example; Jordan's local db connection broke on 2026-09-30 because his .env.local lacked it.

Primary keys for any new table in acme-platform must be UUID v7, generated app-side with uuidv7() via $defaultFn in drizzle; not serial and not UUID v4. New tables also follow the convention of org_id, created_at and deleted_at columns and an index on org_id. Migrations are generated with `pnpm --filter api db:generate` into apps/api/drizzle/ (latest: 0031_brisk_payment_reminders).

Worker shutdown in acme-platform: on SIGTERM the worker stops taking jobs and drains in-flight ones with a 30s grace period (GRACE_PERIOD_MS in services/worker/src/shutdown.ts), matched by terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30 in infra/helm/worker/values.yaml. Pods get killed mid-job during deploys: image-resize jobs can exceed 30s and w.close() can still pick up one more job. Priya says it is on our side; proposed fix (not yet made): pause workers before close and raise both values together (e.g. 90s app, 100s Helm).

Invoice PDF downloads are named invoice-<number>-<client-slug>.pdf (e.g. invoice-0042-smith-jones.pdf) using slugify in apps/api/src/lib/slug.ts; the clients list search (GET /v1/clients?q=) is debounced 300ms on the web side.

Jordan asked for a notification-preferences settings page shell (heading + empty form) in the dashboard but deferred it ('later'); the assistant was unsure of the web app's routing setup and should inspect apps/web and match existing settings screens.

Terraform state for acme-platform lives in S3 bucket acme-tfstate (key platform/prod.tfstate, us-east-1, encrypted) with DynamoDB lock table acme-tfstate-lock, configured in infra/terraform/backend.tf. A committed backend_override.tf (b27f9aa) forced a local backend and made CI plans show 47 resources to add; removed on branch acme-438-remove-tf-local-backend (commit 5e0a1c4), not pushed and no PR yet. Anyone who ran terraform init with the override must run `terraform init -reconfigure`.

infra/ and .github/ in acme-platform are platform-owned: infra changes need a platform-team reviewer (Priya) and the plan output pasted in the PR description (for the Terraform backend fix, a plan showing 0 to add).
Jordan's side project is trailmix, a Django app with HTMX partials and Hike/Photo models; he sometimes asks Django ORM questions in work sessions.
Code style in acme-platform TypeScript: 2-space indentation, single quotes, semicolons, imports with external packages first then local.

Lena owns the apps/web/messages files (e.g. en.json) and is mid-refactor on them as of 2026-10-02; do not edit them. Jordan reverted a 'recieve' typo fix in en.json (paymentPending string) for this reason and may mention the typo to Lena.

`pnpm --filter api db:seed` seeds local data: orgs Northwind Studio (120 clients, 640 invoices) and Bluebird Agency (45 clients, 210 invoices). API tests use their own Testcontainers database, so seeding does not affect them.
Jordan planned a long-weekend hike near Tobermory (Bruce Peninsula) right after 2026-10-02.
Jordan prefers shorter, tighter replies from the assistant (asked on 2026-10-05: 'you're being kinda long-winded, tighten it up').

tsx ^4.20.3 was added to packages/cli devDependencies so scripts (gen:completions, check:size) run directly from .ts without building; package.json was edited by hand and the pnpm lockfile was not yet updated (no install run), so run pnpm install before committing.

deps-bot's @types/node 20.14.10 -> 20.16.5 bump (#493) breaks the packages/cli typecheck with 7 errors, because src/http.ts imports Response from 'undici' while globals come from @types/node and the DOM lib. Proposed fix, not yet applied (Jordan said 'later'): drop the undici type import, use global types and remove "DOM" from the CLI tsconfig lib.

Cron jobs in the acme-platform worker are BullMQ repeatable jobs defined in services/worker/src/schedules.ts via upsertJobScheduler (no system cron or k8s CronJob). nightly-digest runs at 07:00 America/Toronto (moved from 06:00 on 2026-10-05); billing-sync every 15 min; purge-soft-deleted Sundays 03:30 UTC.

Jordan wants to add the k6 load test suite (about 40 min, hits staging) as a GitHub Actions CI job. The existing ci.yml has a single `check` job with timeout-minutes: 20 on every PR/push, so k6 would need its own job with a longer timeout, ideally workflow_dispatch or scheduled. No known team rule; .github/ is platform-owned, so check with Priya first.

Rule in acme-platform: every acme CLI command (packages/cli) must support --json output for scripting; JSON mode emits plain objects with fixed, stable keys (no colors, no table), mapped explicitly rather than passing the API payload through.

As of 2026-10-07 the acme CLI commands org list, org switch and clients list still lack --json (whoami and invoices list have it); they should get it per the --json rule. printJson in packages/cli/src/output.ts is reusable.
Jordan planned to tag the acme-platform release on 2026-10-09 (the 9th) to roll out PR #1192 (acme invoices list command).

The API's Postgres pool size is the env var PG_POOL_MAX (apps/api/src/env.ts, no default, not set in the api helm chart); the value comes from the synced secret and is unknown from the repo. Staging 'sorry, too many clients already' means pods x pool size exceeds the DB max_connections.
Jordan has a Django side project called trailmix (htmx-based trail list, deployed on fly.io); it lives at /Users/jordan/code/trailmix. Trail.difficulty was made nullable (null=True, blank=True).

Gotcha: GET /v1/invoices returns the legacy key `items` instead of `data` when an org has no invoices; the CLI falls back to `items` then []. Remove the workaround once ACME-418 lands (API inconsistency, separate fix needed).

Gotcha: acme-platform route tests (e.g. orders.test.ts) use containers via setup-db.ts and time out in beforeAll if the Docker daemon isn't running; on Jordan's Mac Docker is OrbStack, start it with `orb start`.
To see a terraform plan locally for acme infra: run `make plan ENV=staging` from the infra/ directory. Priya reviews infra changes and wants the plan output attached to the PR.

Staging redis parameter group maxmemory-policy was changed from volatile-lru to noeviction in PR #1189 (branch acme-398-redis-param-group); with noeviction, writes fail with OOM errors once memory is full instead of evicting keys.

Random ~1 in 200 API 401s on staging were JWT clock skew (TokenNotActiveYet nbf / TokenExpired off by 1-2s) on two pods vs Clerk; fixed with clockSkewInMs: 5_000 on verifyToken in apps/api/src/plugins/auth.ts (branch acme-447-jwt-clock-skew). Checking chrony on those nodes was suggested.
Jordan's code rule: no comments that restate the code; comment only the why.

Rule for the acme worker (services/worker): every job handler must be idempotent, using the job id as the idempotency key (webhooks handler uses redis key idem:webhooks:<job id> with SET NX, marked done after success, 24h expiry).
Jordan prefers concise answers; he asked for shorter replies after long explanations.
Code convention: prefer named exports; no default exports except Next.js pages (packages/cli/src/version.ts still has one).
Python scripts in tools/ use Python 3.12 managed by uv (inline script header, run with `uv run tools/<script>.py`).

The api helm chart has readiness and liveness probes on /health (path guessed, needs confirming against what the API serves). A staging 5xx spike on 2026-10-12 was caused by a deploy rolling pods before they passed readiness.

Gotcha: the Stripe webhook route /v1/webhooks/stripe needs the raw request body (fastify-raw-body registered with global:false, route config rawBody:true) or signature verification fails; stripe.webhooks.constructEvent must get the raw Buffer, not JSON.stringify(req.body).

Billing/Stripe code (apps/api billing, stripe webhook route and event handlers) should be left uncommitted for Jordan's review before commit; the raw body change and the handlers-map refactor of stripe-events.ts were left waiting for review.

release.yml builds api and worker images and pushes them to AWS ECR repositories acme/<service> (acme/api, acme/worker) in us-east-1 (account 111122223333), tagged with the git tag and sha-<commit>. Prod worker ran acme/worker:v2026.10.06 on 2026-10-09. Build job timeout raised from 15 to 25 minutes.
